_note: Needs an operator installed cluster-wide — CloudNativePG here (v1.30.0 on the test cluster). The CR deliberately sets no imageName: the operator picks the operand image, which is the ownership point the lab makes, and it is also what lets the manifest run on any cluster whose platform team configured the operator. Verified on the test cluster: a 1-instance Cluster reaches 'Cluster in healthy state' in about 40 seconds.

steps.run: oc get crds | grep -i postgresql | head -5
oc get cluster sample-db -o wide || oc get cluster.postgresql.cnpg.io sample-db
